title: SpatialForge benchmark ground truth (spatialforge-ground-truth/1)
description: Hand-measured (tape or laser) truth for ONE property. All lengths are metres, areas square metres. Every key except schema, property_id and rooms is optional: whatever is missing is reported as NOT EVALUATED, never as a pass.

physical_measurement.description: true only for real tape/laser measurements. Anything else (examples, values read off a reconstruction) is labelled NOT PHYSICAL GROUND TRUTH BENCHMARK in every report.

repeat_group.description: Captures of the same room/property share this id (repeatability).

capture_id.description: Which capture this file describes within the repeat group, e.g. 'A' or 'B'.

id.description: Your own name for the room, e.g. 'kitchen'.

predicted_id.description: Optional: the room id in property.json (room_001). Without it rooms are matched by floor area, conservatively.

polygon.description: Optional [x, z] corners in metres, in any frame; only the shape is informational.

predicted_id.description: Optional: the wall id in property.json (wall_003).

room_id.description: A room id from 'rooms' that the opening is in.

adjacency.description: Pairs of room ids that are directly connected.
